name: ga4gh-pedigree skill
summary: Structurally validate a GA4GH pedigree document (a family-structure record of members and their parent relationships)
description: Bundled Claude Code / MCP skill for GA4GH pedigree, shipped alongside the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ga4gh-pedigree` Cordis plugin and standalone MCP server in the `ga4gh-plugins` monorepo. Structurally validate a GA4GH pedigree document (a family-structure record of members and their parent relationships). Use when the user provides a pedigree/family-structure JSON document and asks whether it is well-formed, or asks for its member count or structural errors (missing ids, duplicate ids, or parent references to members that do not exist in the document).
